title: POV: "Support" DMs you first
summary: A stranger in your DMs says he is from wallet support and needs you to "verify" your wallet. We follow the trick step by step and show the one habit that stops it: real support never messages you first.

chapters.title: Why real support never DMs you first

ZOO's one fix: only use support links from the official site
